title: Parameter-Free Dynamic Regret under Heavy-Tailed Noise
abstract: arXiv:2607.27073v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: We study online convex optimization with stochastic gradient noise whose conditional $p$-th central moment is bounded by $\sigma^p$, for an unknown $p\in(1,2]$. For losses with Lipschitz bound $G$ on a domain of diameter $D$, we obtain expected universal dynamic regret $\widetilde O(GD\sqrt{T\Lambda}+\sigma DT^{1/p}\Lambda^{(p-1)/p})$, where $\Lambda=1+P_T/D$ and $P_T$ is the path length of a fixed comparator sequence. The algorithm combines restarted AdaGrad experts with an adaptive entropy-regularized master, uses one stochastic gradient per round, and requires no knowledge of $G,\sigma,p$, or $P_T$. Its iterates are invariant under positive rescaling of the gradients. The analysis controls comparator movement within restart blocks before taking expectations, yielding the noise path exponent $(p-1)/p$ rather than the exponent $1/2$ of a direct non-restarted extension. translated_title: 重尾噪声下的无参数动态遗憾
translated_abstract: 我们研究在线凸优化问题，其中随机梯度噪声的条件 $p$ 阶中心矩被 $\sigma^p$ 所界定，而 $p\in(1,2]$ 是未知的。对于在直径为 $D$ 的定义域上具有 Lipschitz 界 $G$ 的损失函数，我们获得了期望通用动态遗憾界 $\widetilde O(GD\sqrt{T\Lambda}+\sigma DT^{1/p}\Lambda^{(p-1)/p})$，其中 $\Lambda=1+P_T/D$，$P_T$ 是固定比较序列的路径长度。该算法将重启的 AdaGrad 专家与自适应熵正则化主算法相结合，每轮仅使用一次随机梯度，且不需要知道 $G$、$\sigma$、$p$ 或 $P_T$ 的任何信息。其迭代点在梯度的正数缩放变换下保持不变。该分析在取期望之前控制重启块内比较序列的移动，从而得到噪声路径指数 $(p-1)/p$，而非直接非重启扩展所给出的指数 $1/2$。同时给出了一个匹配的随机一阶预言机下界……
tldr: 该论文提出了一种无需预知噪声矩参数、Lipschitz 界、梯度尺度及比较序列路径长度的在线凸优化算法，通过重启 AdaGrad 专家与自适应熵正则化主算法的结合，在重尾噪声下实现了具有噪声路径指数 $(p-1)/p$ 的最优通用动态遗憾界。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a parameter-free online convex optimization algorithm combining restarted AdaGrad experts with an adaptive entropy-regularized master, achieving optimal universal dynamic regret under heavy-tailed noise with the noise path exponent $(p-1)/p$, without requiring knowledge of the moment parameter, Lipschitz bound, gradient scaling, or comparator path length.
